column4: The elephant has a long nose.

The clock is on the wall.
Pick a number from one to ten.
I drew a picture of my dog.
We learn new things at school.

I want to buy a gift.
I think it's a good plan.
We saw lions at the zoo.
Look both ways on the street.

I am scared of the dark.
